title: Close
tagline: A voice sales agent for a staffing consultancy, running entirely on Agora's native Custom Tools (no LLM adapter, no extra hop).
description: Close is a real-time voice sales and qualification agent built for a staffing/recruitment consultancy scenario. Agora's managed LLM handles all reasoning and turn-taking natively, calling a FastAPI backend directly via Custom Tools for pricing, lead capture, meeting booking, and escalation, with real Google Calendar, Google Sheets, and Resend integrations.
author: Swati Aggrawal
